title: Two Distinct Bullets in a Simple List

illustrates.quote: a. Follow print for the symbol used as a bullet. If the print symbol does not have a corresponding symbol in braille, devise a symbol using a transcriber-defined symbol indicator. (See UEB, §3.26, Transcriber-Defined Symbols.)

blocks.features: Four items; the first three carry a small round bullet, the fourth a visually distinct solid square bullet.

items.text: Where did the Neolithic agricultural revolution occur, and how did it affect the lives of men and women?
What are the characteristics of civilization, and what are some explanations for why early civilizations emerged?
How did geography contribute to the civilizations that arose in Mesopotamia and Egypt?
In what ways were the civilizations of Mesopotamia and Egypt alike? In what ways were they different?
items.features: square bullet, visually distinct from the other three round bullets

print.printFeatures: Styled heading; three items with a small round bullet, one item with a visually distinct solid square bullet.

Line 1 carries the heading.
